messages.text: Where is my order? Order #····-A, email (email hidden)
Handed to the team · Order 4 weeks old with no ship date and no inbound stock for either SKU; previou

Still nothing moved, and I'm sorry, you were promised a date last time and never got one. Both lines on Shop···· are waiting on stock at our warehouse: the NerdQaxe++ and the Bitaxe Supra Hex 703. Neither has an incoming shipment I can point to, so I won't invent a date.

I've pinged Abel and Georges to settle this one properly. Stay in the chat and they'll jump in here; if you step away it comes to your email.

If you'd rather not keep waiting, I can swap either line to something that's on the shelf now, or sort a refund.
Hey Sarah, it has been a few hours, is there any updates from Abel or Georges?

Nothing new on the order yet, both lines still sitting on stock, and no reply logged from Abel or Georges. I'm sorry you're waiting again.

They're on until 6pm Eastern, so stay in the chat if you can; if you step away the answer goes to your email.

In the meantime I can act myself: I can swap either line to something on the shelf now, the Hammer BC04 at $239 for the NerdQaxe++ for instance, and it would ship in a couple of days. Want me to price that out?

Well Sarah, swapping the BSB NerdQaxe++ for the Hammer Miner BC04 would be an even exchange in terms of hashrate, but it would leave a $10 price difference in your favor. Would you instead be able to swap the BSB NerdQaxe++ for the NEXUS QX1 and the Bitaxe Supra Hex 703 for the Hammer Miner BC04? Together, those two swaps would give me an additional 3.8 TH/s at a net additional cost of just $9 to you. Alternatively, would it be easier for you to refund my payment of 0.003474 BTC? I ordered these miners with the understanding that they were available, since they were listed as in stock at the time of purchase. It has now been a month, and there is still no clear timeline for when they will be back in stock.

Both swaps are doable. Quick honesty first: the QX1 isn't on our shelf, it ships from the manufacturer by Oct 15. The B.04 is in stock and ships within 2 business days.

Money: the QX1 is $1 less than the NerdQaxe++, refunded to your payment. The B.04 is $10 more than the Supra Hex, so a $10 invoice comes by email and that line ships once it's paid.

Say the word and I'll do both now. If you'd rather have the refund, I'll hand that to Abel instead.
I think I would rather get a refund for my 0.003474 BTC to the wallet of my choice if that is possible
Handed to the team · Refund request on a crypto-paid order, payout wallet to confirm; not mine to iss

Understood, and that's fair after a month of waiting. Nothing has shipped, so there's no fee of any kind on it.

The refund itself, and paying it out in BTC to a wallet you pick, is Abel's or Georges' call, not something I can run myself. I've passed it to them with the order and the amount. They're on until 6pm Eastern, so stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here; if you step away it comes to your email.
